method: After that, we were briefed on global feminisms, which began with a chat about the computer programmer Ada Lovelace, which then launched into an exploration of global feminisms. Also covered was the topic of intersectionality.
related_work:
There was a discussion of the BFI Expanded trip in London. The primary activity of the trip were 2 VR exhibitions, focused on flooding. One of them, "The world came flooding in" was focused on the stories of Australians and the homes and objects that were left behind by flooding, Solwata, meanwhile, was more focused on the Solwata people as they navigate the flooding of Walande. Another exhibition, Water Body, was also focused on water, and had the participant hold a basin of water. 

The stories reflected the way climate change affected communities due to increased flooding, and they provided a way to speak to the participant in a way that was personal and relatable. They provided effective means of storytelling, and of showing the consequences of climate change.
title: BFI London, Feminism and Intersectionality
introduction: For this weeks lesson, there was a discussion of the London trip that preceded it which involved VR exhibitions on the topic of flooding, and also video games, and then it focused on feminism and the topic of intersectionality.
